crossRefs.note: As they came, when David returned from the slaughter of the Philistine, the women came out of all the cities of Israel…
The women sang to one another as they played, and said, “Saul has slain his thousands, and David his ten thousands.”
The servants of Achish said to him, “Isn’t this David the king of the land? Didn’t they sing to one another about him…
He who blesses his neighbor with a loud voice early in the morning, it will be taken as a curse by him.

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: Isn’t this David, of whom people sang to one another in dances, saying, ‘Saul has slain his thousands, and David his ten thousands?’ ”
translations.bsb: Is this not the David about whom they sing in their dances: ‘Saul has slain his thousands, and David his tens of thousands’?”
translations.kjv: Is not this David, of whom they sang one to another in dances, saying, Saul slew his thousands, and David his ten thousands?
translations.asv: Is not this David, of whom they sang one to another in dances, saying, Saul hath slain his thousands, And David his ten thousands?
